pmtiles.js — vendored third-party library
=======================================

Source:  https://unpkg.com/pmtiles@4.3.0/dist/pmtiles.js
Project: https://github.com/protomaps/PMTiles
Version: 4.3.0 (IIFE bundle)

Why it is vendored
------------------
MapLibre GL JS cannot read a PMTiles archive without this library: the `pmtiles://` protocol
handler lives here, not in MapLibre. On Android and iOS MapLibre Native resolves the protocol
internally and this file is never loaded — see
`lib/features/safe_places/data/hazard_protocol_stub.dart`.

It is committed to the repo, rather than loaded from a CDN, on purpose:

- The app is offline-first. A CDN `<script>` on the boot path means a slow or unreachable CDN
  breaks start-up, which would contradict the whole premise of the app.
- `registerPmTilesProtocol()` runs inside `main()`. Without this library the `pmtiles` global is
  undefined and the `@JS()` call throws, which would stop the app before its first frame.

Updating
--------
Re-download the IIFE bundle and record the new version in the filename and above. The
`pmtiles://` source URL and the registration in `main()` must stay identical after the
`pmtiles://` prefix: the library matches archives by `getKey()`, which is the string handed to
`FetchSource`. See `lib/features/safe_places/data/map_style.dart`.
